scenes.narration: ~Get out. One thought makes it through the fog in your head. Get Moose. Get air.
scenes.visual: you on the basement floor, GET OUT

scenes.narration: You crawl up the stairs. Every step takes forever.
Moose is lying by the front door. You talk to him like he understands. Come on, buddy. We're going.
You drag him across the floor... and shove the door open into the storm.
scenes.visual: front door bursting open into snow

scenes.narration: The cold hits you like a wall. You breathe. And breathe. And breathe.
scenes.visual: you in the snow, breath clouds, the dog beside you

scenes.narration: Your hands are shaking. Nine one one. Carbon monoxide. Please hurry.
scenes.visual: phone screen glowing in the snow

scenes.narration: Moose lifts his head. Then his tail. Once.
scenes.visual: dog lifting his head, tail wag

scenes.narration: The fire crew finds it fast. A cracked furnace. An exhaust buried in snow. Another night, they say... and you wouldn't have woken up.
scenes.visual: fire truck lights in the snow

scenes.narration: No ghosts. Just a poison you can't see or smell.
scenes.visual: the farmhouse from outside, red lights

scenes.narration: If everyone in a house feels sick at once, even the pets... get out, get fresh air, and call for help. And get a carbon monoxide alarm.
That night, in a motel room, Moose sleeps against your feet. You finally sleep too.
scenes.visual: motel room, you and the dog asleep

scenes.narration: Until three in the morning... when something whispers... ~hear that?
scenes.visual: dark motel room, the air vent above the bed

scenes.narration: Hear that? Tell me in the comments... and follow. Tomorrow... a new story.
scenes.visual: end card: HEAR THAT? / NEW STORY TOMORROW
